newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Yahoo! cut to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Yahoo! cut to buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it cut its rating on Yahoo! Inc to buy from strong buy "based strictly on valuation" of the stock.
-- In a statement, analyst Paul Noglows said the company remains on track to meet or beat his first quarter earnings forecast of nil per share on revenues of $8.6 million.
-- Noglows said traffic on the company's web search engine continues to build at all sites, with its Japanese service now logging over two million page views per day.
